text: Photography is an art form that captures the world around us through a combination of light and shadow, allowing us to record and interpret the beauty and essence of our surroundings. Shutter speed is the length of time the camera's shutter remains open, determining how long the camera is exposed to light. Aperture is the size of the lens opening, affecting how much light enters the camera. Both of these elements, together with the medium (a lens, a sensor, or a film), are crucial in creating a visually striking image.
